scope: Release portability and computational checks only; synthetic smoke checks are not benchmark retraining or independent confirmation of published metrics.
portability_changes: Package-relative imports replace local sys.path and production src imports.
Data directory is explicit (--data-dir or CTR_DATA); import without datasets is supported.
Unused one_epoch_diag/bench_criteo dependency and obsolete standalone CondPyramid screen were removed.
Unused legacy production pml/pyramid/pml_res/pml_gate branches raise explicit NotImplementedError. Published saved arms do not select these branches.
CLI accepts an arm JSON file as well as the original JSON string. Any failed arm now produces a nonzero process exit status.
Training math, model operations, parameter initialization and RNG ordering are unchanged in the published experiment paths.

source_equivalence_check.preserved: Original metadata field count, embedding dimensions, all saved dense widths/operators/normalization/loss settings.
source_equivalence_check.comparison: torch.equal on every state_dict entry after seeded initialization, eval forward logits, scalar train loss, and every parameter gradient (including matching absent gradients).
source_equivalence_check.tolerances: Exact equality; no numerical tolerance used.
source_equivalence_check.models: 11 Table-1/source configurations plus 18 Table-2 pyramidal/budget configurations. Rank-W DCNv2 is included because Table 2 starts from that setting.
source_equivalence_check.method: Original x4_runner and package-relative release imported side by side; torch.manual_seed reset before constructing each model and before each training loss.

source_equivalence_one_epoch.note: Temporary synthetic data and results were removed automatically; no real benchmark training was run.

checks: PyramidDCN recurrence and original-input coordinate selections with an independent formula calculation.
Small synthetic forward, finite training loss, finite backward gradients for PyramidDCN and all nine baseline families.
One-epoch train/validation/test through the standalone package CLI and JSON-file arm input.
Build, eval forward, train loss and backward for every distinct recorded configuration, preserving original dense widths and replacing embedding vocabulary only.

limitations: No full benchmark retraining or GPU/MPS/CUDA smoke test was performed for this release verification.
Exact source-equivalence comparison covers 29 Criteo configurations; all 225 distinct stored configurations were additionally checked for valid forward/loss/backward in the portable release.
Post-training effective-rank/funnel/AGOP analysis is outside the full-catalog model smoke pass.
Package versions describe the tested environment, not a claim that other versions reproduce identical benchmark metrics.
